definitions.explanation: A book containing practice problems or exercises for study, typically used for test preparation or skill building.

examples.japanese: {問題集|もんだいしゅう}を{解|と}く。
examples.english: To work through a problem set.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}{対策|たいさく}のために{問題集|もんだいしゅう}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a workbook for exam preparation.

examples.japanese: この{問題集|もんだいしゅう}には{解説|かいせつ}が{詳|くわ}しく{載|の}っている。
examples.english: This workbook has detailed explanations included.

notes:
{問題集|もんだいしゅう} is a book of practice problems used for study and test preparation. The word combines {問題|もんだい} (problem/question) and {集|しゅう} (collection).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {問題集|もんだいしゅう}を{解|と}く (to work through a problem set)
- {問題集|もんだいしゅう}を{買|か}う (to buy a workbook)
- 〜の{問題集|もんだいしゅう} (workbook for ~, e.g., {数学|すうがく}の{問題集|もんだいしゅう})

COMMON TYPES:
- {過去|かこ}{問題集|もんだいしゅう}/{過去問|かこもん}: past exam question collection
- {演習|えんしゅう}{問題集|もんだいしゅう}: practice exercise book
- {入試|にゅうし}{問題集|もんだいしゅう}: entrance exam workbook

USAGE:
Central to the Japanese study culture of repeated practice ({反復|はんぷく}{練習|れんしゅう}). Students commonly buy {問題集|もんだいしゅう} for specific exams or subjects. Many come with separate {解答|かいとう}{解説|かいせつ} (answer explanations) booklets.

RELATED TERMS:
- {参考書|さんこうしょ}: reference book (explanations, not just problems)
- {教科書|きょうかしょ}: textbook
